title: Correct final time
description: Essential Criteria: The final answer must be 10 minutes.

title: Equal travel times
description: Important Criteria: The solution must state or use that the police and criminal travel for the same time interval.

title: Police distance equation
description: Important Criteria: The distance BE must be correctly expressed using the Pythagorean theorem with BC and (CD + DE).

title: Criminal distance equation
description: Important Criteria: The criminal's total distance (AD + DE) must be correctly expressed using the Pythagorean theorem for AD.

title: Solve for CD
description: Important Criteria: The equations must be set equal and solved to find CD = 3 km.

title: Unit conversion
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should correctly handle unit conversion from hours to minutes.

title: Incorrect distance setup
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the police car's distance is incorrectly calculated as sqrt(BC^2 + CD^2) + DE.

title: Sign or arithmetic error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize for algebraic or arithmetic mistakes in solving the equation sqrt(36+(CD+5)^2) = sqrt(16+CD^2)+5.
